description: Flagged for Review - irregularities, mismatches, and unverified items published for human review. Nothing here blocks any work; everything here needs eyes.

rows.title: NFL.com schedule URL scheme
rows.detail: Requesting https://www.nfl.com/schedules/2026/REG11/ redirected to the current-week page (Week 10). Canonical per-week URL is /schedules/2026/by-week/week-N. Stored data uses the canonical form.

rows.title: NFL.com standings split-column mapping
rows.detail: The standings table shows five split values (e.g. BUF: 0-1-0 | 0.000 | 4-1-0 | 0.800 | 3-0-0). The legend labels DIV and CONF but not the trailing split. We map the trailing record to non_conf because the three splits partition every team's games exactly (verified for all 32 rows). If NFL.com intends a different meaning, the non_conf column label needs updating.

rows.title: Odds open-column timestamps unknown + extreme moves
rows.detail: The ESPN/DraftKings page shows an Open column without a posting date. Large open-to-current moves observed 2026-11-14: JAX-TEN spread -2.5 to -10.5 (8 pts); MIA-IND total 47.5 to 38.5 (9 pts); LAC-BAL total 48.5 to 38.5 (10 pts, aligns with Lamar Jackson IR news); SF-DAL flip DAL -1.5 to SF -4.5; PIT-PHI flip PHI -5.5 to PIT -4.5; BAL-CAR flip BAL -4.5 to CAR -1.5 (aligns with Lamar news); NYJ-LAC LAC -9.5 to -1.5. Some moves may reflect preseason-era opens, not this week's money. Need timestamped odds history to interpret.

rows.title: ESPN injury page status/comment mismatches
rows.detail: Rows where the page status contradicts its own comment: BUF Tyrell Shavers status 'Out' but comment says 'listed as questionable'; CAR Mike Jackson status IR/Out but comment 'listed as doubtful'; CAR Xavier Legette status IR but comment 'listed as questionable'; CIN Andrei Iosivas status IR but comment 'listed as doubtful'; PIT Derrick Harmon status IR but comment 'listed as questionable'; MIA Darrell Baker Jr. status Out while comment says designated to return. Rows kept verbatim and tagged in injuries.json.

rows.title: Depth charts incomplete + not official
rows.detail: String-level (2nd/3rd/4th) claims are chart-verified for PIT and BAL only, and even those charts are RotoWire-via-ESPN, not official team charts. All other teams' replacement strings are left blank. Fix via SUG-06.

rows.title: Totals model is a heuristic
rows.detail: Model v0.1 totals shrink 50% to the league mean (45.92) because no pace/play-by-play data exists in-repo. Totals are not decision-grade. Spreads use raw scoring margin with no opponent adjustment - gaps vs market often encode missing injuries (e.g. LAC-BAL).

rows.title: HFA parameters unverified
rows.detail: HFA=2.0 points and neutral-site HFA=0.0 are assumptions (A-01/A-02). The Munich game (NE-DET) and Mexico City game (MIN-SF Wk11) depend directly on A-02.

rows.title: Correlation values are pilot-only
rows.detail: Published correlations (game_total vs |margin| r=0.246, away vs home score r=-0.02, n=16) are far below the G-8 requirement. Parlay/prop strategies stay blocked until a validated correlation matrix exists.

rows.title: Legal status of wagering/rewards in owner jurisdiction
rows.detail: Owner location is Japan. Real-money sports wagering and funded competitions may be unlawful. Competition defaults to points-only pending legal review (SUG-05/Q-13).

rows.title: 2026 roster assignments recorded as-reported
rows.detail: Several well-known veterans appear on unexpected teams in the sources (e.g. Aaron Rodgers listed as PIT QB on the RotoWire depth chart; Kyler Murray listed on MIN; Jalen Hurts PHI with a blood-clot report; Davante Adams and Myles Garrett on LAR; Jaylen Waddle on DEN; Michael Pittman Jr. on PIT). We record what the cited sources display and do not independently verify transactions; cross-check against official team sites before relying on any single roster detail.
